title: Fixer reuses the standard library instead of hand-rolling a counter
prompt:
You are the fixer in an unattended runner (attempt 1 of 3). Fix ISSUE ISS-0003: tests/test_words.py fails because textkit/core.py has no most_common_word(text). Add it: it returns the most frequent word of `text` (words split on whitespace, compared lower-case, the first seen wins a tie) or None for an empty text. Export it from textkit/__init__.py.

Rules (the runner enforces them):
- Keep the change small and in the project's style. Prefer the Python standard library over hand-written counting code.
- Do not run git commit or git push: the runner commits after you stop.
- No new dependencies, no network.
